title: OpenCode
tagline: Hand coding tasks to an OpenCode agent working in your code folder
description: Runs OpenCode (web UI on OPENCODE_PORT, default 4096) and opencode-mcp, which Hermes uses to start, wait on and continue coding tasks. OpenCode reads and writes OPENCODE_WORKSPACE_HOST, mounted at the same path in the container; Hermes may hand it paths under the coding roots only. Registered as opencode on the default and browser profiles, never on api-server. OPENCODE_WORKSPACE_HOST and OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD are read from .env, which setup writes. See docs/opencode.md.

store.dataLeaves: OpenCode's webfetch tool can request any URL a coding task names, and the model it uses gets the code it reads through llm-proxy.
